channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Davion Mitchell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Davion Mitchell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Heat Central:Stan Van Gundy is OUT on the Miami Heat and says Bam Adebayo is overrated.

“I’m not as high on Miami as people are… The shooting they added compromises them badly on the defensive end of the floor. Even though he was great last year, I’m not sold on Davion Mitchell as a full time starting PG… I’d actually be surprised if they were in the top 6… I’m not a fan of their roster. — I think Wiggins is underrated but I think Bam is a little overrated, particularly at the offensive end of the floor. I’m not sold on them.”

Stan Van Gundy on Davion Mitchell, Oct 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo on being in Miami:

“Coach Spo brings the best out of players. I want to be coached hard…. I want people when they’re at work thinking about the Heat. I want people when they’re at their couch watching their favorite show to turn that off and put the Heat…I’m very excited to get in the gym with Bam, Mitchell, Wiggins, all these great players, Jovic.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Andrew Wiggins, Davion Mitchell, Nikola Jovic, Jul 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Antetokounmpo on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Heat Central:Giannis’ brother Alex Antetokounmpo on Davion Mitchell:

“Amazing defender. Great playmaker as well. I think that he’s a really good player. They call him off night for a reason.”

Alex Antetokounmpo on Davion Mitchell, Jul 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jamal Shead on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
I asked Jamal Shead on facing his former teammate Davion Mitchell vs Heat:

“It felt like training camp... I learned so much from him... I wouldn’t be in this position... without him. I just took what I could from him... was really helpful that I got to be his backup...”

Jamal Shead on Davion Mitchell, Dec 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Miami and Memphis continued to trade punches down the stretch, with the Heat taking a 106-105 lead on a Davion Mitchell three-pointer with 2:01 to play.

“I really felt like once Davion hit that three, I thought we were winning this game,”

Erik Spoelstra on Davion Mitchell, Apr 4, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Pat Riley on Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell and Andrew Wiggins:

“They are now officially part of what we do believe in, which is our culture here with the Heat. And we believe they are perfect players to be part of that. I think they’ll show it.”

Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Feb 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Bronny James:

“Guys like Davion Mitchell, Jrue Holiday, and Derrick White who excel in their role, get good money and get good playing time from it because they’re locked into that role and know what they’re supposed to do.”

Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on Davion Mitchell:

“He definitely stands out on tape because of his ability to pressure the ball, his awareness, and his defensive feel. He looks like a really good young player. He's a great pick for them.”

Steve Kerr on Davion Mitchell, Oct 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.
